name: Ituero y Lama (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, green above and below and white at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ituero y Lama (a Roman milestone inscribed VERO on green, and fleurs-de-lis).
history: Ituero y Lama adopted its arms and flag on 22 November 2000, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 23 February 2001; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, divided per saltire into four parts, the upper and lower green and the lateral ones white, with the crowned arms of the town of Ituero y Lama superimposed at the centre.
